name: Kashimori Mitsuki
source:
"...I'm not qualified to be your friend. But... it seems it's inevitable that you'll talk with me."

2nd year high school student.
Star Sign: Pices
A classmate with a mysterious air.

He may look like a dazzlingly handsome guy, but he has no self confidence.
He's so solemn that the other students keep their distance from him so he thinks they hate him.
A pure person who believes anything somebody says.
He really hates ghosts and other monsters.
